nodes.label: Rocket98 Goblin Full Assembly
nodes.description: 98mm diameter Goblin-style single-stage rocket: gray nosecone, yellow body tube with avionics window, coupler band, and fin can with four fins

nodes.label: Upper Body Tube w/ Avionics Window
nodes.description: Yellow upper body tube section with rectangular avionics access cutout

nodes.label: Coupler Band (gray)
nodes.description: Gray ring between upper and lower tubes, marking coupler joint

nodes.label: Lower Body Tube
nodes.description: Yellow lower body tube spanning to the fin can

nodes.label: Goblin Fin Can
nodes.description: Yellow fin can with integral swept trapezoidal fins (appears 4-fin)

nodes.label: Motor Retainer Ring
nodes.description: Small ring visible at base of fin can retaining motor
